test_title: PYST 2: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

I will finish this book in a month.

options.text: This book would be finished by me in a month.
This book will be finished by me in a month.
Will be book finish by me in a month.
Will this book be finished by me in a month?

solution:
The correct answer is **"This book will be finished by me in a month."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

__
 
• The given sentence is in Simple Future Tense and in Active Voice.
 
• The rule for changing a Simple Future Tense from Active voice to Passive voice or Passive to Active Voice:
 
 
• Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e., the object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.
 
 
 
• Structure: 
 
 
• Subject + will + V1 + object (Active Voice__)
 
• Object + will + be + V3 + by Subject __(Passive Voice)__ 
 
 
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *Esha will sing a song.** *(Active Voice)
 
• *A song will be sung by Esha.​ *(Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject is **"I"** performing the action.
 
• To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object **("this book")** the subject, and use the auxiliary verb **"will be"** followed by the past participle of the main verb **("finished")**.
 
• The preposition **"by"** is used to indicate who is performing the action **(in this case, "me")**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.
